_readme: Curated, finite backlog for the Palm Jebel Ali page factory. Each entry becomes ONE content file. 'file' is relative to lib/content (no .ts). A topic is 'pending' if that file does not exist yet; 'built' once it does. The factory works top-to-bottom, 5/day, and STOPS when everything is built. Top up this list to add more. ALL content must obey the fact-discipline in scripts/PAGE_FACTORY.md: only numbers from lib/content/palm-facts.ts, no fabricated prices/yields/specs, competitor & visa/tax specifics kept qualitative and hedged, pre-handover realities stated honestly. image = a key of IMG in palm-facts.ts.
